title: Cross-Domain Exact Compatibility Replication, Coexistence Orthogonalization, Authority-Lifecycle Decoupling, Intervention-Matrix Construction, Dependency-Edge Orientation, Primitive-Promotion Replication & the Court of Whether Context Coordinates Admit Stable Independent Structure

targets.COMPATIBILITY_OBLIGATION: Obtain a second exact discriminator in a distinct software domain.
targets.COEXISTENCE_REQUIREMENT: Hold compatibility obligation fixed while varying simultaneous old/new operation requirement.
targets.RELEASE_AUTHORITY: Hold lifecycle phase fixed while varying who may perform the mutation or release action.

promotion_rule.stable_primitive: At least two exact cross-domain discriminator families, representation-invariant replay, negative control, and no unresolved dependency collapse.
promotion_rule.bounded_only: One exact domain or multiple near-matched domains remain bounded and may not be promoted.
promotion_rule.merge_rule: If target variation cannot be isolated from another coordinate under admitted interventions, retain dependency/merge candidate rather than primitive status.

intervention_matrix.requirement: Each promoted primitive must have action discrimination with all non-target action-relevant state held materially equivalent.

authority_lifecycle_decoupling.required: Same lifecycle phase, same G, materially same E, different actor/permission/release authority, different permissible action.
authority_lifecycle_decoupling.forbidden_substitute: Release-cut vs ordinary-PR contrasts where lifecycle changes together with authority.

coexistence_orthogonalization.required: Same compatibility obligation and same G,E, differing only whether old and new surfaces must operate simultaneously.
coexistence_orthogonalization.forbidden_substitute: Legacy consumer contrasts where compatibility itself changes.

r2_gate: LAW-R2 remains unauthorized unless fresh normalized same-(X,G,E) conflicting action survives P14's intervention and dependency reconstruction.
